headlines.headline: GIANNIS'S MOVE TO MIAMI HEADLINES LOADED PRESEASON BEFORE OCT. 21 TIP-OFF
headlines.detail: Giannis Antetokounmpo is settling into a 'fresh start' with the Miami Heat after an offseason trade, while Victor Wembanyama has climbed past Nikola Jokic on the early MVP ladder and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has stacked a streak of 20-point games beyond a mark long held by Wilt Chamberlain. The regular season tips off Oct. 21.

headlines.headline: BILLS AT RAMS HEADLINES MONDAY NIGHT PRIMETIME SLATE
headlines.detail: Tonight's Monday Night Football matchup, Buffalo at the Rams (8:15 p.m. ET, ESPN/ABC), kicks off after this brief goes out, with Los Angeles favored by 3.5 points at home in the week's marquee primetime game.

headlines.headline: OKLAHOMA STUNS TEXAS IN RED RIVER RIVALRY, GEORGIA JUMPS TO NO. 1
headlines.detail: Oklahoma beat No. 6 Texas 27-24 in the Red River Rivalry Saturday — Arch Manning threw a late interception that set up Oklahoma's game-winning field goal — dropping Texas to No. 7 in the AP poll. Georgia moved to No. 1 after beating Alabama 20-17.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA OPENS AS NO. 1 IN PRESEASON TOP 25 AS TIP-OFF NEARS
headlines.detail: With the season opening Nov. 2, Florida sits atop ESPN's preseason Top 25. Rosters across the sport are being reshuffled by the NCAA's new age-based eligibility rules, which did not grandfather in seniors who expected one more year, sparking several player lawsuits.
